question: According to the professor, how were the leaves of this manuscript pricked?

options.A: One sheet at a time, with the holes in both margins, inner as well as outer
options.B: A gathering at a time, with the holes in both margins, inner as well as outer
options.C: A gathering at a time, with the holes in the outer margin only
options.D: One sheet at a time, with the holes in the outer margin only
